kind: OWNER CANDIDATE DEPENDENCY MAP; NOT A FROZEN REVIEW RELEASE, NEW AUTHORITY OR ADOPTION

strongest_independent_test_domain.scope: Self-contained full original complex-source T2 dual inequality for every rank2 projector with both marginal supports≤2, including entangled/NPT ones; strict if both local squares nonnormal. Unpaid dual domain necessarily has at least one marginal rank≥3.

independent_ppt_support_bridge.scope: Self-contained direct proof every rank2 PPT projector is separable and has both marginal supports≤2, except common-factor cases which also have supports≤2. NPT projectors may still have low supports; the primary theorem directly covers those too.

separable_equality_refinement.scope: Separately proves all separable rank2 projector dual bounds and stronger equality necessity that one local FACTOR is normal. The local-support primary subsumes its non-strict test-domain coverage but asserts only one local SQUARE normal at equality.

scope_rules: All owner proofs UNREVIEWED. A new frozen review can choose primary, optional PPT bridge and/or separable equality, with exact pins in frozen release; any earlier review remains unchanged and this map itself grants no access or adoption.
limits: No general proof for all test projectors with a local marginal rank≥3; special cases, including maximally mixed marginals, were separately paid. No η>2L/f274-complement member, physical/q counterexample, unrestricted T2/T3/Z2/q3, selected q/numeric/program, source correctness, formal/independent-family/human review or novelty. All old process/STOP/HOLD/ZERO restrictions remain binding.
